address: 8 bis rue des Gobelins, Paris, 75013, France
bio: The warm air of the Sirocco has reached Les Gobelins, bringing its fragrances of tajines, couscous and hariras into the old stables of the Château de la Reine Blanche, where this Moroccan restaurant with typical decor is located. The owner himself imports the argan oil that flavours his traditional dishes. Of course the couscous itself is home-made, and very fine, just as it should be....
